description: This file defines the PdfSecuritySettings class, which manages security and permissions settings for a PDF document within the PDFsharp library. It includes properties for passwords, encryption status, and various permissions such as printing, modifying, and extracting content.

classes.name: PdfSecuritySettings
classes.description: Manages security settings, permissions, and passwords for a PDF document in the PDFsharp library.

methods.name: CanSave
methods.description: Checks if the document can be saved based on current security settings and passwords.
